1) 09:00 — 09:15 Welcome + objectives (Grace O'Connor)
2) 09:15 — 10:45 Executive briefing: finance & data priorities (Grace to moderate; Presenters: Vivek Kulkarni, Marissa Cole)

6) 13:30 — 15:00 Breakout B — Integration & security constraints (Marissa Cole)
7) 15:00 — 16:30 Synthesis + next actions (Grace + client leads)

Day 2
- Deep dive into rollout scenarios, measurable KPIs, and mutual action plan. Owners: Vivek (rollout), Rishi (metrics).

Pre-reads: one-pager read-ahead for execs (attaches: read_ahead_onepager.pdf) and a short attendee-bio pack (attendee_bios.xlsx). We need the CFO's one-sheeter (2 paragraphs) + any slides from Veridian presenters by Dec 3 EOD.

Travel/logistics notes:
- Presenters should arrive Dec 7 evening if they want a tech check on Dec 8 at 08:00.
- If anyone needs hotel booked, indicate preferred chain and nights; we'll coordinate travel approvals.

Next steps: Marissa will own the AV runbook and presenter slide checklist; Rishi will draft the breakout facilitation guides; Vivek will draft the executive briefing slide deck outline. Grace will consolidate and send the official read-ahead by Dec 3.
